description: This PHP class defines a model for calculating the subtotal in an OpenCart shopping cart, including loading language files, retrieving cart subtotal, and updating totals.

classes.name: SubTotal
classes.description: A class extending the system engine model to compute and add subtotal information to the cart totals.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the cart subtotal, updates the totals array with subtotal details, and increases the total amount.
